# ShadowWatch fixture

Dependency files copied unmodified from the public repository
https://github.com/karthikmukesh19-gif/ShadowWatch at commit
4c8057c3bbed0e55f916341187cf4f2d3ddaaea6, plus `FILES.tsv` (size and path of
every tracked file at that commit, used for language detection).

The tests serve these files through a simulated GitHub API, so the whole
pipeline runs on real repository content without network access.
